body.p: Applicant replies to the Office Action dated October 15, 2024, within three months.

Applicant thanks the Examiner for her indication that claim 8 would be allowable if re- written in independent form. Applicant amends claim 1 to be claim 8 re-written in independent form. Accordingly, Applicant asserts that claim 1 is in condition for allowance.
The Examiner objects to claim 7 for a minor informality. Applicant amends claim 7 and asserts that the informality has been obviated.

The Examiner rejects claims 1-6 under 35 U.S.C. 102 as being anticipated by U.S. PG Pub. 2005/0033555 (Tanner). Applicant respectfully disagrees; however, Applicant amends independent claim 1 to incorporate allowable subject matter. Accordingly, Applicant asserts that claim 1 is in condition for allowance.

The Examiner rejects claim 7 under 35 U.S.C. 103 as being unpatentable over Tanner in view of U.S. PG Pub. 2022/0161326 (Nelson). Claim 7 depends from amended independent claim 1, which is amended to incorporate allowable subject matter. Accordingly, Applicant asserts that claim 7 is in condition for allowance at least based on its dependency from claim 1.

In view of the foregoing, Applicants respectfully submit that all of the pending claims are allowable over the cited references. Reconsideration of the application is respectfully requested. Should the Examiner wish to discuss any of the above in greater detail or deem that further amendments should be made to improve the form of the claims, the Examiner is invited to contact the undersigned at the Examiner's convenience. The Commissioner is authorized to charge any fees due to Deposit Account No. 19-2814, including any required extension fees. This statement does not authorize charge of the Issue Fee.
